tools.name: vipari.list_available_tools
tools.title: List available tools
tools.description: Return the current principal's granted scopes and the broker-exposed tools available to this token.

tools.name: vipari.list_repos
tools.title: List workspace repositories
tools.description: List repositories allocated to the authenticated workspace with lightweight posture context.

tools.name: vipari.get_repo_posture
tools.title: Get repository posture
tools.description: Return the current review posture, top reasons, and next action for one workspace-visible repository.

tools.name: vipari.get_repo_casefile
tools.title: Get repository case file
tools.description: Return a compact repository case file with baseline status, leading findings, and review targets.

tools.name: vipari.list_escalations
tools.title: List workspace escalations
tools.description: Return the workspace escalation queue with review-now and optional watch items.

tools.name: vipari.get_export_status
tools.title: Get export status
tools.description: Return the current status for one workspace-owned compliance export job.

tools.name: vipari.create_compliance_export
tools.title: Create compliance export
tools.description: Create a low-risk compliance export job for one workspace-visible repository.

tools.name: vipari.list_baseline_proposals
tools.title: List baseline proposals
tools.description: List baseline proposals for one workspace-visible artifact.

tools.name: vipari.create_baseline_proposal
tools.title: Create baseline proposal
tools.description: Create a low-risk baseline proposal for one workspace-visible artifact.

tools.name: vipari.list_onboarding_proposals
tools.title: List onboarding proposals
tools.description: List onboarding proposals for the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: vipari.create_onboarding_proposal
tools.title: Create onboarding proposal
tools.description: Create a low-risk onboarding proposal for a repository in the authenticated workspace.

tools.name: vipari.add_audit_feedback
tools.title: Add audit feedback
tools.description: Append low-risk structured feedback to an existing repository audit visible to the workspace.

tools.name: vipari.triage_audit
tools.title: Triage audit
tools.description: Record a low-risk triage state transition for an existing repository audit visible to the workspace.
